team.title: Built by people who were tired of juggling five tools
team.description: Nexora started as an internal tool for a small outbound team stitching together a spreadsheet, a generic CRM, and a few different AI writing apps just to send one campaign. We built the platform we wished we had — and now we're building it for you. We're a small, product-obsessed team, and we read every piece of feedback ourselves.

pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing

items.question: Do I need my own list of leads to get started?
items.answer: No. Use Search Leads to discover companies by country, industry, and keywords, then import the ones you want to work.

items.question: Can I bring my own email provider?
items.answer: Yes. Campaigns are designed to work with a transactional email provider you connect from Settings once you're ready to send.

items.question: Is there a free plan?
items.answer: Yes, the Free plan includes limited lead searches and one active campaign so you can try the full workflow before upgrading.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Subscriptions are month-to-month and can be canceled from Settings → Subscription at any time.
